release: v1.6.0-beta.0
source:
  general/  <- https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-spec-tests/releases/download/v1.6.0-beta.0/general.tar.gz
  minimal/  <- https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-spec-tests/releases/download/v1.6.0-beta.0/minimal.tar.gz

extraction recipe (same shape as docs/design/003-ssz-verifier.md Appendix B):

  curl -sL https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-spec-tests/releases/download/v1.6.0-beta.0/general.tar.gz \
    | tar -xz --wildcards 'tests/general/*/bls/eth_fast_aggregate_verify/*'
  curl -sL https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-spec-tests/releases/download/v1.6.0-beta.0/minimal.tar.gz \
    | tar -xz --wildcards '*/light_client/sync/*' '*/light_client/update_ranking/*'

  then `tests/general -> general/`, `tests/minimal -> minimal/`.

contents:
  general/altair/bls/eth_fast_aggregate_verify/bls/   12 cases
      The only BLS suites present in this release are `eth_fast_aggregate_verify`
      and `eth_aggregate_pubkeys`; the older phase0 `verify` / `aggregate` /
      `fast_aggregate_verify` / `hash_to_G2` suites are NOT in v1.6.0-beta.0.
      `eth_fast_aggregate_verify` is the suite that pins the Ethereum
      domain-separation tag `BLS_SIG_BLS12381G2_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_POP_`,
      because its signatures were produced under it.
  minimal/<fork>/light_client/sync/pyspec_tests/       altair..fulu, 4 cases each
      Full light-client sync scenarios: bootstrap.ssz_snappy, N update_*.ssz_snappy,
      steps.yaml, meta.yaml (genesis_validators_root, fork digests), config.yaml
      (fork versions/epochs). MINIMAL preset: SYNC_COMMITTEE_SIZE = 32,
      SLOTS_PER_EPOCH = 8, EPOCHS_PER_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PERIOD = 8.
  minimal/<fork>/light_client/update_ranking/pyspec_tests/
      `is_better_update` ordering vectors. M4 v1 deliberately does not implement
      `is_better_update` / `best_valid_update` (design doc 004 §6.6); retained so
      that decision can be revisited with data.

notes:
  * `.ssz_snappy` here is RAW snappy block format, not the snappy FRAME format.
    Use `cramjam.snappy.decompress_raw`, not `cramjam.snappy.decompress`.
  * Spec source pinned alongside: consensus-specs tag v1.6.0-beta.0
    (configs/mainnet.yaml, presets/mainnet/altair.yaml,
     specs/altair/light-client/sync-protocol.md,
     specs/electra/light-client/sync-protocol.md).
  * The SSZ single_merkle_proof subset lives separately under
    tests/fixtures/ssz/consensus-spec-tests/ (vendored by M3 from the same
    release) and is what pins design doc 004's fork-gindex table.
